e.summary: IFoA 随机准备金工作组经典导读论文（Carrato/McGuire/Scarth）：R 代码 + 论文，随机准备金入门圣经
e.body: PSRWP（Pragmatic Stochastic Reserving Working Party）是 IFoA 随机准备金工作组的经典成果：《A Practitioner's Introduction to Stochastic Reserving》，作者 Alessandro Carrato、Gráinne McGuire、Robert Scarth。仓库包含论文 PDF/HTML 全文与配套 R 代码，系统讲解 Mack 模型、ODP 链梯、自助法（bootstrapping）、MCMC 等随机准备金方法——被广泛视为随机准备金的入门圣经，比 [[stochastic-reserving-england]]（England & Verrall 论文代码）更偏教学导入。对 RIAA 学生：学准备金先从这篇入手再上手 [[chainladder]]。关联 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

e.body_en: PSRWP (Pragmatic Stochastic Reserving Working Party) is a classic deliverable of the IFoA's stochastic-reserving working party: 'A Practitioner's Introduction to Stochastic Reserving' by Alessandro Carrato, Gráinne McGuire and Robert Scarth. The repo ships the full paper (PDF/HTML) with companion R code covering Mack's model, ODP chain ladder, bootstrapping, MCMC and other stochastic reserving methods — widely regarded as the go-to introduction, more teaching-oriented than [[stochastic-reserving-england]] (England & Verrall code). For RIAA students: start with this paper before hands-on work with [[chainladder]]. Related: [[reinsurance]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
